title: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL 13 is in extended support
summary: The Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL version policy lists PostgreSQL 13 with extended support starting 2026-02-01 and deprecation on 2029-02-01. The PostgreSQL community no longer supports 13, and Cloud SQL charges for extended support.

sources.title: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL database versions and version policies

constraints: Cloud SQL moves an instance to extended support when the PostgreSQL community reaches end of life. Extended support is time-boxed to three years and is charged.
Changing database_version can upgrade the instance in place or recreate it, depending on the target. Read the plan before applying and take a backup first.
A major version upgrade cannot be reversed by changing database_version back; restore the backup instead.

steps.title: Back up the instance
steps.instructions: Take an on-demand backup of every Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL 13 instance reported, before changing its major version.

steps.title: Upgrade the instance
steps.instructions: Upgrade the instance to PostgreSQL 14 or later with Cloud SQL's in-place major version upgrade, or restore the backup into a new instance on the replacement major and move the application connection string.

steps.title: Raise the declared version
steps.instructions: Change database_version in every google_sql_database_instance and google_sql_source_representation_instance block that runs this database, using the POSTGRES_ prefix for the replacement major.

steps.title: Check clients and extensions
steps.instructions: Update PostgreSQL drivers, ORMs, extensions, and any maintenance or backup automation that names PostgreSQL 13.

verification.purpose: Check that the Terraform configuration is valid with the new database_version.
Review the plan and confirm the database_version change is intended and is the only instance change.
Confirm each reported instance now reports a supported PostgreSQL database version.
Confirm any local Compose service that mirrors this database is valid and uses a PostgreSQL image tag that matches the replacement.
